scope: Three complete guarded native bodies, full original RAM/CPU/FPU/FPUL/MACL/stop state and ordered calls. Independent identity-transform predicate/scalar evaluation and sequential raw-float state/overlap writes.
limitations: Predicate independent checks use identity XMTRX and finite masked narrow arithmetic; vector arithmetic differential checks share the pinned backend core. No physical hardware numerical or pixel proof.
PR/SZ/RM/trap/RAM guards publish reached state rather than delivering CPU exceptions. Wide stack stores can overwrite saved PR and produce an expected return guard.
Actual AL_MAIN draw caller integration is separately scoped. Names, clipping purposes and field meanings remain inferred.
